steps.title: Fragment Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Fragment the genomic DNA to the desired library sizes using the appropriate ultrasonicator.

substeps.instruction: Use a Covaris E220 ultrasonicator to obtain ~2 kb fragments.
Use a Hydroshear (GeneMachines) to obtain ~5 kb, ~10 kb, and ~20 kb fragments.

steps.title: Repair DNA Fragments
steps.instruction: Repair the fragmented DNA using T4 DNA polymerase (Enzymatics).

steps.title: Add Biotin Label
steps.instruction: Label the DNA fragments using Biotin dNTP Mix (Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher).

steps.title: Select Fragment Sizes
steps.instruction: Perform agarose gel electrophoresis to select fragments within the following size ranges: 2–2.4 kb, 5–5.5 kb, 10–11 kb, or 20-23 kb.

steps.title: Cyclize DNA Fragments
steps.instruction: Connect the DNA into rings and cyclize the fragments.

substeps.instruction: Use T4 and T3 DNA ligase (T3 from Enzymatics) to connect the ring.
Use a Covaris LE220 to cyclize the DNA fragments.

steps.title: Ligate Adaptors
steps.instruction: Perform adaptor ligation under specific temperature and vibration conditions.

substeps.instruction: Vibrate at 1000 rpm for 15 seconds every 2 minutes.
